request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Pontus they came, Aquila and wife
Leaving Rome behind, obeying life
Claudius sent the Jews away
To Corinth they traveled that day

[Verse]
Paul found a trade they all could share
Tentmaking work was in the air
He stayed with them, they worked as one
A fellowship under the sun

[Chorus]
Priscilla and Aquila
Guiding us to see
The way of God is clear
In their home for free

[Verse]
To Ephesus they sailed along
Paul went on, they stayed among
They heard Apollos speak in bold
And took him aside, calm and old

[Pre-Chorus]
They explained the path more true
With wisdom and with love anew
The church met in their house today
Serving God in his own way

[Chorus]
Priscilla and Aquila
Guiding us to see
The way of God is clear
In their home for free

[Verse]
They risked their lives for Paul’s sake
For Christ’s love they never break
The Gentile churches owe them thanks
Faithful servants, kind and ranks

[Chorus]
Priscilla and Aquila
Guiding us to see
The way of God is clear
In their home for free

[Outro]
Greet them warmly in the Lord
Their story is our word
